text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Time came back. Reps saved roughly 5 hours a week on post-call admin. Most of it went to prep and follow-up.

2. CRM data got better. Notes were consistent, so pipeline reviews stopped being guesswork.

3. Consent matters. Asking customers upfront took ten seconds and built trust instead of eroding it.

4. Summaries aren't strategy. The tool captured what was said, not what was meant. Reps still had to read the room.

5. Adoption followed managers. Teams used it when leaders referenced the notes in coaching.

The biggest lesson: AI handles the record. People handle the relationship.

What's your team's experience with AI note-takers?
